title: Stable domestic life during change

captions.energy: Ending former arrangements before clear continuation

meaning: Your domestic support keeps its steadiness when ending an outdated form rests on understanding the task and leaves both a clear arrangement during change.
text: You can sustain domestic life through thoughtful actions: understanding a need, choosing usefully and considering accumulated experience. The Hermit in the physical position of Muladhara describes this aspect. Death in energy complicates it through excessively rapid ending of familiar forms. The Emperor in emotions wants steadiness and clear boundaries. The wish to release something old can precede the ability to live differently. The previous order is cancelled, but neither yet knows where things belong, who is responsible or which temporary method remains shared.

For example, you decide to remove a bulky chest of drawers and immediately empty it. Belongings cover the room although no new place exists. **Ending something old is easier with clear support for present life.** You can separate unnecessary items from those needing temporary storage. Experience releases space without losing orientation, while change need not prove its seriousness through instantly rejecting every remainder of the former arrangement.

The difficulty is experiencing temporary support as going backwards. Separation from the old form accelerates, but elementary clarity must then be recreated. Proportionate completion helps more dependably: the unnecessary genuinely leaves while current needs receive a place. Thoughtfulness supports change when it helps both live through it in a usable home instead of among demonstrations of how decisively something was rejected.
